name: Human Resource Onboarding & Employee Integration
description: Deterministic strategic framework to orchestrate employee onboarding, 30-60-90 day milestone roadmaps, legal document execution, IT account provisioning, and time-to-productivity (TTP) optimization.
frameworks: 5-Phase Onboarding Lifecycle Model (Pre-Boarding, Day 1 Orientation, 30-Day Integration, 60-Day Competency, 90-Day Autonomy)
Mandatory Compliance Document Matrix (PIIA, Form W-4, Form I-9, Offer Letter)
logic: An employee's first 90 days dictate long-term retention, engagement, and performance. Unstructured onboarding, delayed IT account access, missing legal documents (PIIA), or ambiguous 30-60-90 day goals increase early turnover and inflate time-to-productivity. Execute frictionless, audit-ready employee onboarding.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Initiate Pre-Boarding Audit -> Verify Executed Offer Letter, PIIA & Tax Forms (W-4/I-9) -> Provision System Accounts & Hardware
Step 2: Day 1 Orientation & Welcome -> Introduce Team Buddy, Deliver Systems Access & Assign Organizational Memory Learning Modules (okd_01)
Step 3: Synthesize 30-60-90 Day Milestone Roadmap -> Define 30-Day Learning Goals, 60-Day Role Competency & 90-Day Autonomous Deliverables (spe_01)
Step 4: Time-To-Productivity (TTP) & Efficiency Analysis -> Measure Days to First Independent Output, Onboarding Cost & Manager Feedback Scores
Step 5: Executive Sign-Off & HR Verification -> Broadcast WebSocket Approval Request via ExecApprovalManager for Onboarding Completion
Step 6: Export Onboarding Package -> Generate Onboarding Blueprint JSON, Checklist CSV, 30-60-90 Dashboard HTML & Manifest -> Archive in Vault
Step 7: Continuous Integration & Milestone Monitoring -> Register Alert Triggers in PCL Daemon -> Flag Overdue 30/60/90 Day Milestones
bestPractices: Ensure 100% of legal documents (PIIA, Offer Letter, W-4/I-9) are fully executed before Day 1.
Assign a dedicated peer onboarding buddy to every new employee to accelerate cultural and technical integration.
Require explicit manager sign-off on 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day performance milestones.
